note: The official IESO site (ieso-info.org) is dead (domain parked) and the IGEO past-exam archive (igeoscied.org) is blocked from this container, as is web.archive.org. The only reachable archive is the Japanese Earth Science Olympiad committee (www.jeso.jp/exam/ieso.html), which mostly hosts Japanese translations. years[] holds only original-English papers; fallback_ja holds the Japanese translations and answer keys (several of which are the official English/language-neutral keys) in case the site wants them - they break the "original language only" rule, so use with care.
